cohort: Pregnant women at ≥20 weeks of gestation receiving ≥8 units of red blood cells within 24 hours of giving birth
finding: Massive transfusion due to postpartum haemorrhage is associated with high rates of morbidity and hysterectomy.
mod_finding: This study found that 69% of women who underwent massive transfusion following postpartum hemorrhage had a cesarean section.
